description: Lets clients' email replies reach a coach's Pistachio workspace on a receive-only subdomain (reply.<domain>), through Resend: the DKIM key and the MX that hands the subdomain's mail to Resend. Apply it to the reply subdomain only, never to a domain that already receives mail.
variableDescription: %dkim%: the DKIM public key Resend issues for the subdomain (the base64 part after p=). %region%: the Amazon SES region that receives for it, e.g. eu-west-1.
